mapper.select:
SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId,/* add by songyawei */ ENTRUST_ID code FROM ETR_ENTRUST
AND ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_STATUS IN(#{entrustAwait},#{entrustDistribute},#{entrustReceive},#{entrustUntread},#{entrustClose})
AND ENTRUST_ID like concat(concat('%', #{entId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')

SELECT T1.PORTFOLIO_ID code, T1.PORTFOLIO_NAME shortName FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO T1 INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY T2 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T2.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T2.USER_ID = #{userId}
T1.PORTFOLIO_ID like concat(concat('%',#{param,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR T1.PORTFOLIO_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{param,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')

SELECT FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID hidCode, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR shortName FROM FIN_PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.FINPROD_ID
(FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID like concat(concat('%',#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%',#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
AND FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_8 IS NOT NULL AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F01','F06','F10')
UNION ALL SELECT TARGET_ID hidCode, TARGET_ID code, TARGET_NAME shortName FROM OPT_TARGET_INFO
(TARGET_ID like concat(concat('%', #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR TARGET_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))

SELECT FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID hidCode, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR shortName FROM FIN_PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.FINPROD_ID
(FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID like concat(concat('%',#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%',#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
AND FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_8 IS NOT NULL AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 not in ('F01','F06','F10')

SELECT distinct SYS_USER.USER_NAME id, SYS_USER.REAL_NAME text ,SYS_USER.DEPT_CODE deptCode /* add by songyawei */ FROM SYS_USER INNER JOIN SYS_USER_ROLE ON SYS_USER.USER_NAME = SYS_USER_ROLE.USER_ID INNER JOIN SYS_ROLE ON SYS_USER_ROLE.ROLE_ID = SYS_ROLE.ROLE_ID
AND SYS_ROLE.ROLE_POS IN( #{roleOne}, #{roleTwo} ,#{roleThree})
AND (SYS_USER.USER_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{manager,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR SYS_USER.REAL_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{manager,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
SELECT PA_ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_TIME.VDATE vdate, PA_ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_TIME.MDATE mdate FROM PA_ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_TIME
SELECT T1.REAL_NAME realName FROM SYS_USER T1 where T1.USER_NAME = #{userName}
mapper.insert: insert into PA_ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_TIME (VDATE, MDATE,REMARK, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values (#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{mdate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(T1.BID_PRIN_AMT) bidPrinAmt, LISTAGG(T1.BID_PRICE * 100 ||'%',',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY T1.BID_PRICE) bidPrice, T2.ENTRUST_DATE bidDate FROM ETR_ENTRUST_BID_PRICE T1 LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID=T2.ENTRUST_ID WHERE T1.ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId} GROUP BY (T2.ENTRUST_DATE)

SELECT T2.TRADER trader FROM ETR_ENTRUST T1 INNER JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T2.ENTRUST_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T3.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID WHERE T1.ENTRUST_DATE = to_date(#{bussBidDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND T3.Finprod_Market_Id = #{finprodMarketId} GROUP BY T2.TRADER

select listagg(ea.DISPENSE_PARA,',') WITHIN GROUP ( order by er.VDATE) distributeParameter, er.DISPENSE_RULE distributeRule, er.VDATE vdate, er.MDATE mdate from ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE er left join ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE_DETAIL ea on er.RULE_ID = ea.RULE_ID
and er.VDATE <= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') and er.MDATE >= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
group by er.DISPENSE_RULE, er.VDATE, er.MDATE

select a.user_id userName,c.real_name realName,
regexp_replace(LISTAGG( d.asset_type, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (d.asset_type)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') finprodType2,c.DEPT_CODE deptCode from sys_user_role a inner join sys_role b on a.role_id = b.role_id inner join sys_user c on a.user_id=c.user_name left join AUTO_DISPENSE_RIGHT d on a.user_id=d.user_id where b.role_pos = '06' group by a.user_id,c.real_name,c.DEPT_CODE
